newsitem.title: UNITED NATIONS: Iran denies any involvement in Saudi bombing.
newsitem.headline: Iran denies any involvement in Saudi bombing.

text.p: Iran's U.N. mission expressed outrage on Wednesday over media reports implying Iranian involvement in a bombing in Saudi Arabia in June which killed 19 U.S. servicemen.

The Iranian statement followed a report in the Washington Post that Saudi Arabia had given the United States detailed data to support the Saudis' belief that the bombing of the U.S. military complex was carried out by Shi'ite extremists trained in Lebanon and backed by Iran.
The Iranian U.N. mission said in a statement it was "outraged about the recent media reports implying Iranian involvement of some sort in the bombing which took place in Saudi Arabia in June."
It said these press reports were "invariably based on conjectures and cynical speculations" and were devoid of any specific attribution or evidence.

Saying this and other allegations had been rejected in August, it added: "The new round of campaign is no different, and while deploring such glaring exploitation of public opinion, the permanent mission of the Islamic Republic of Iran hereby explicitly denies, for the sake of record, any and all sorts of involvement with the bombing in Saudi Arabia."
